output.summary: A biennial or short-lived perennial herb native to southern Europe and parts of Asia, sweet William bears dense clusters of spicy, clove-scented flowers. Wild flowers are red with white bases, while cultivated forms include white, pink, red, purple and patterned colours. Its flowers are considered edible, although the source marks this claim as needing a citation.
